title: FLA round-trip fidelity test suite for symbol/tween documents
description: E2E test that opens a known FLA fixture with symbols/tweens/scripts, publishes a SWF, loads it in Ruffle, and asserts pixel parity against a reference capture. This is the regression harness called out in docs/00-overview-and-architecture.md accuracy strategy. Gates against regressions across the full author→compile→play pipeline.
